## Services

AI Kollege offers a free self-assessment, individual paid learning passes, business AI readiness audits, team training sprints, and scoped implementation support. Business, team, and implementation services begin with human review and agreed scope.

## Truth and boundaries

AI Kollege is not an accredited college, university, degree program, or professional licensing body. It does not guarantee jobs, income, promotions, savings, or business outcomes. Learner proof packs are learner-created course work, not accredited credentials or employer endorsements.
